text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the veterinarians and support staff at this Upper East Side clinic for their empathy and thorough medical attention. Multiple clients highlight Dr. Facison for gentle exams, patient listening, and deep kindness during difficult moments and end-of-life care. While an occasional review reflects frustration, most clients report high satisfaction with the staff.

Several reviewers appreciate the clinic's clear communication, noting prompt email replies, swift lab result delivery, and thorough explanations of medical care. Clients also praise smooth handling of pet travel certification paperwork. However, some owners experienced inconsistent guidance, delayed updates during ongoing illness, or difficulty getting full information about test results.

title.en: Reasonable rates with occasional unexpected fees

text.en: Opinions on veterinary pricing are divided among pet owners visiting this Manhattan practice. Several clients note fair, transparent rates for routine exams and appreciate when veterinary staff consider financial constraints without pressuring add-on procedures. Conversely, other clients mention high initial walk-in fees and unexpected charges when undergoing advanced diagnostic work.

q.en: Can Carnegie Hill Veterinarians issue international pet travel certificates?

a.en: Yes, clients report smooth assistance from veterinarians and staff when preparing official international travel and health certificates.

q.en: What should clients expect regarding examination costs?

a.en: Reviewers note transparent fees for routine appointments, though some mention baseline consultation charges around $100 before extra tests.

q.en: How quickly are lab test results delivered?

a.en: Clients frequently receive laboratory findings the following day, followed by email communication with the veterinarian.
Carnegie Hill Veterinarians is located at 1707 3rd Avenue on Manhattan's Upper East Side.
